name: plan-p2-pay-first-regional
about: A planned campaign (V2c, prompt v5): the P2 starter preset written from the idea the Strategist recorded for "first-campaign-regional" — the pay per mile for regional flatbed work. Every candidate should lead with the idea and state only the brief's facts.

area.label: Fixture Yard, IL
area.reason: Fixture: drivers within a day's drive of the yard.

subject_matter.in_our_words: A small fleet where dispatch knows your name

recipe.name: The number
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with the pay figure alone, exactly as the brief states it and with its unit (per mile, per week, per year). If the brief states no pay, lead with its strongest other figure (a bonus, home days, miles) — never a figure the brief does not hold. Who the job is for (the licence, the kind of run) goes in a few words on the small line above it, never in the pay line.
recipe.image_prompt_template: A plain {surface} background, {texture}, {light}, a soft {tone} gradient, nothing in the frame, no text, no logos, no lettering

angle.idea: Lead with the pay per mile, stated plainly, over a loaded flatbed rolling on a Midwest highway.
angle.proof: The opening states its pay per mile, and the work is flatbed on Midwest lanes.

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc pays $0.68 per mile for Class A flatbed on Midwest lanes. You get an assigned truck, home weekly and a 401k. We are a small fleet, and dispatch knows your name.
en.headline: Flatbed on Midwest lanes
